Class Abilities

1st Level

All of the following abilities are gained at 1st level. Each uses the associated attribute for checks.

Study

  • Effect: As your action, study one creature you can see; from the start of your next turn it is your Studied target until the end of the encounter. You may study before a fight. A Death Attack needs two rounds of study at 1st level, and one from 7th.

Death Attack

  • Effect: Once per encounter against each Studied target, the first Sneak Attack that hits it and deals damage, once it has had the study a Death Attack needs, is a Death Attack: the target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or dies instantly.
  • Death Attack works only on a target whose Level does not exceed your Assassin level plus 2.
  • Against a solo, a failed save is a kill effect: it deals damage equal to the solo's current HP instead (see Solo Creatures, Book IV).
  • Later hits on it that encounter are normal Sneak Attacks.
  • Save succeeds: attack deals the maximum on its Sneak Attack dice instead

Sneak Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (see the Assassin Progression Table) against a creature that cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is your Studied target. Usable once per round.
  • Usable at range within 30ft
  • No prior stealth check required
  • A Death Attack is delivered by a Sneak Attack; if the target saves, it takes maximum Sneak Attack dice damage

First Blood

  • Effect: Your Sneak Attack against a creature that has not yet acted this encounter deals one extra die.

Killer's Precision

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage. This applies to every hit, not only Sneak Attacks. Improves to +2 at 7th level and +3 at 15th.

Assassin's Skills

  • Effect: Trained in Climb, Disguise and Traps (Book II), on top of your 3 starting skills, and Master in Traps from 7th level. You roll Climb with Dexterity. Hide and Move Silently count as Stealth, and Listen as Perception, for kits, feats and other features.
  • Case Target (Wisdom): spend 1d3×10 minutes observing a target. On a successful check you learn its approximate Level, its Allegiance (most mortals are Unaligned), any hidden weapons or unusual items, and its habits and mannerisms; the GM adjusts for the target's power.
  • Disguise (Charisma): 1d3×10 minutes for a general disguise, 1 month for a specific individual; apparent height and weight change by no more than a tenth. The GM rolls secretly, and the more your disguise differs from your own build, age and ancestry, and the more suspicious the observer, the harder the check.
  • Hide, Move Silently (Dexterity) and Listen (Wisdom): your pace sets the roll. Half speed or less: Advantage. Normal speed: a normal roll. Running or charging: Disadvantage.
  • Lightly obscured: you count as Hidden while lightly obscured even on a result of 12 to 14.
  • Together: from 3rd level you may attempt Hide and Move Silently together, at quarter speed, with Disadvantage on both.
  • Identify Poison (Intelligence): identify any poison or antitoxin on a successful check, and make poisons or antitoxins with alchemical equipment for a third of their street value. You never risk poisoning yourself when applying poison to a blade.

2nd Level

Quiet Kill

  • Effect: A creature you reduce to 0 HP or below with a Sneak Attack makes no sound as it falls. Nearby creatures get no check to notice the kill by sound alone.

3rd Level

Ambush Predator

  • Effect: You have Advantage on initiative.

4th Level

Poisoner's Edge

  • Effect: A poison you apply to a weapon lasts for 3 hits instead of 1, and the target makes its save against it with Disadvantage.

5th Level

Twist the Knife

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • No Disadvantage against a Poisoned creature.
  • If both attacks hit one creature, it can't regain Hit Points until the end of its next turn.
  • Sneak Attack still applies to only one attack per round.

6th Level

Dossier

  • Effect: After a successful Case Target check you have Advantage on checks to track or tail that creature for a day, and it is your Studied target from the start of your next fight with it.

7th Level

Lethal Dose

  • Effect: The first hit each fight with a poisoned weapon also deals +1d6 poison damage. The target makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC to negate the extra damage.

Shadow Step

  • Effect: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below with a Sneak Attack, or when you Hide, you may move up to 15ft without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.

8th Level

Many Faces

  • Effect: A general disguise takes 5 minutes, and a disguise as a specific individual takes 1 week instead of a month.

10th Level

Venom Tolerance

  • Effect: You have Advantage on saves against poison.

Finishing Blow

  • Effect: A Sneak Attack against a creature at half its HP or less deals one extra Sneak Attack die (a Sneak Attack die, so a Death Attack the target saves against deals it at maximum too).

Renown: Name

  • Effect: Your deeds are known. Title: A whispered name of your choosing (the Grey Hand, say). Brokers know how to reach you: once per Downtime Phase, a paying contract finds you (the GM's call). Your first follower, a go-between, joins you.

13th Level

Master Poisoner

  • Effect: In downtime you brew poisons in half the time and at half the cost, and you can identify any poison and its antidote.

15th Level

Surprise

  • Effect: Your Hide result counts one tier higher against creatures you ambush.

Reaper's Reach

  • Effect: You can Cleave with any attack, not only a melee weapon, and a Cleave attack can be a Sneak Attack.

Signature Style

  • Effect: Choose one type of attack, poison, or tactic used throughout your career.
  • Once per encounter, when executing a Death Attack using this signature style, the target makes its Fortitude save with Disadvantage.

Cold Blood

  • Effect: Your Sneak Attack dice ignore resistance to physical damage (not immunity), and your Studied target has Disadvantage on its first save against you each encounter, other than a Death Attack save.

Perfect Study

  • Effect: You may study as part of an attack instead of as your action.

Dexterity Bonus

  • Effect: Gain a permanent +1 to Dexterity. It can take the score past 20, to 22 at most (see The Mortal Limit in Character Creation).

Renown: Holding

  • Effect: You may found a safehouse as your Holding (see Your Holding (15th) in Keeps & Kingdoms). Killer's Precision also improves, as its entry says.

17th Level

Clean Exit

  • Effect: After a planned kill, checks to tie it to you have Disadvantage, and you can stage it as an accident or point it at another culprit.

20th Level

Marked for Death

  • Effect: A creature you have a Dossier on makes its Death Attack save with Disadvantage, and Death Attack works on it whatever its Level.

Renown: Shadow Guild

  • Effect: Your stronghold becomes your shadow guild (see Renown in The Arneyan Codex); each season 1d4 apprentices and a poisoner join it. While you hold it, once a season a Dossier arrives unbidden on a creature of your choice, as if you had made a successful Case Target check against it.

Kits: Assassin Guilds and Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Assassin folder. Drag one onto your character.

Choose one Kit at character creation.

  • Your kit defines your guild, tradition, and the network you belong to, or fled from.
  • Each kit reshapes one of your 1st-level features, as its Reshapes line says, and improves at 9th level.
  • The peoples, orders and places a kit names are examples, not the only ones: a kit suits anyone from a tradition like it.
